title: Improving the OOD Performance of Closed-Source LLMs on NLI Through Strategic Data Selection
authors_zh: Joe Stacey, Lisa Alazraki, Aran Ubhi, Beyza Ermis, Aaron Mueller, Marek Rei
paper_type_zh: 固定预算、面向鲁棒性的数据选择研究
best_for_zh: 适合使用 API 微调、且必须通过改变训练集合而非目标函数或优化器来改善分布鲁棒性的读者。
one_line: This study selects or replaces NLI fine-tuning records under a fixed API-training budget to improve OOD robustness of closed-source LLMs.
本研究在固定 API 训练预算下选择或替换 NLI 微调记录，以提高闭源大语言模型的 OOD 鲁棒性。
why: It shows that training-set composition can be the only controllable optimization lever for closed-source fine-tuning and measures the resulting OOD trade-offs.
inclusion_reason: It makes fixed-budget training-data replacement the mechanism for trading in-domain fit against OOD robustness when the fine-tuning algorithm cannot be changed.

title: Problem
问题
html:
API fine-tuning of closed-source models does not permit changing the optimizer, loss, or internal representations. Fine-tuning can improve NLI accuracy on its source distribution while sharply reducing performance on unseen distributions, so the only practical intervention may be which fixed number of records the API receives.

The paper asks how a 10,000-example NLI training budget can be reallocated to preserve or improve OOD robustness. It selects more challenging existing records or replaces a class-balanced fraction with generated examples. The target is not a larger dataset, but a different training-record mixture that changes the robustness trade-off without changing the vendor's training procedure.

闭源模型的 API 微调不允许改变优化器、损失或内部表示。微调可以提高自然语言推理在源分布上的准确性，却显著降低其在未知分布上的表现，因此唯一实际可干预的变量可能就是 API 接收到的固定数量记录。

论文要回答的是，如何重新分配一万个自然语言推理训练例子的预算，以保持或提高 OOD 鲁棒性。它选择更有挑战性的既有记录，或用生成记录替换一个类别平衡的比例。目标不是扩大数据集，而是在不改变厂商训练过程的情况下，用不同的训练记录混合改变鲁棒性取舍。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The training set is treated as a fixed-capacity portfolio. When difficult or uncertain examples enter, equal numbers from each label class leave, keeping both cost and label proportions constant. This makes the resulting performance change attributable to data composition rather than extra training instances or a changed optimization algorithm.

The paper distinguishes two robustness regimes. More challenging annotated examples help challenge-OOD benchmarks, whereas simple generated data tends to help easier standard-OOD benchmarks. Prompting for longer and more complex synthetic examples seeks to close this split, turning generation complexity itself into a controllable property of the fine-tuning mixture.

训练集被视为一个容量固定的组合。当困难或不确定的例子进入时，每个标签类别都有相同数量的记录离开，从而保持成本和标签比例不变。这使所得性能变化可归因于数据构成，而不是额外训练实例或改变后的优化算法。

论文区分两种鲁棒性情形。更有挑战性的人工标注例子有助于挑战型 OOD 基准，而简单生成数据往往有助于较容易的标准 OOD 基准。通过提示生成更长、更复杂的合成例子，方法试图缩小这种分裂，使生成复杂度本身成为微调数据混合中可控制的属性。

title: Method
方法
html:
Starting from an initial NLI subset, the authors build an incoming set and a removed set of equal class-specific size. Incoming examples can be selected by prediction uncertainty, model errors, or LLM-assigned difficulty. To control selection cost, examples outside the initial subset are considered only from a candidate pool with the same size as the initial training subset.

The alternative incoming set is generated NLI data. LLMs produce premise-hypothesis-label triples from new domains, either with a short/simple prompt or a prompt that asks for more complex premises and hypotheses. The final fixed-size data mixture is API-fine-tuned for GPT-4o-mini and Gemini-2.0-Flash, then evaluated on in-distribution, standard-OOD, and challenge-OOD NLI datasets.

从一个初始自然语言推理子集开始，作者构造一个进入集合和一个移除集合，它们在每个标签类别中的数量相等。进入例子可以按预测不确定性、模型错误或大语言模型给出的难度选择。为控制选择成本，初始子集之外的例子只从一个与初始训练子集等大的候选池中考虑。

另一种进入集合是生成的自然语言推理数据。大语言模型从新领域生成前提—假设—标签三元组，可以使用短而简单的提示，也可使用要求更复杂前提和假设的提示。最终固定大小的数据混合会通过 API 微调 GPT-4o-mini 和 Gemini-2.0-Flash，然后在同分布、标准 OOD 和挑战 OOD 的自然语言推理数据集上评测。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that ordinary fine-tuning improves in-distribution NLI while reducing challenge-OOD accuracy substantially; it cites drops of 10.95 percentage points for Gemini-2.0-Flash in its main comparison. Under the fixed 10K budget, uncertainty sampling is the strongest reported selection approach for challenge-OOD settings, while generated data consistently helps standard-OOD datasets.

The results also show the intended trade-off: simple synthetic examples can harm challenge-OOD performance, but increasing generation complexity improves both standard and challenge OOD results. The evaluation spans twelve datasets and more than 2,400 model-dataset evaluations, but remains a single task family and depends on how the authors categorize benchmark difficulty. This is good evidence for the record-mixture mechanism, not a general proof for all instruction fine-tuning.

论文报告，普通微调提高同分布自然语言推理，却大幅降低挑战型 OOD 准确性；在主要比较中，它给出 Gemini-2.0-Flash 下降 10.95 个百分点。在固定一万条预算下，不确定性抽样是挑战 OOD 设置中报告最强的选择方法，而生成数据持续有助于标准 OOD 数据集。

结果也显示预期取舍：简单合成例子会伤害挑战 OOD 表现，但提高生成复杂度可同时改善标准和挑战 OOD 结果。评测跨越十二个数据集和 2,400 多次模型—数据集评估，但仍属于单一任务族，且取决于作者如何划分基准难度。这是对记录混合机制的良好证据，而非适用于所有指令微调的一般证明。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Its novelty is practical rather than a new preference or loss objective. It formalizes data replacement as the available optimization surface when a provider locks the fine-tuning process. The explicit class-balanced replacement rule turns difficulty, uncertainty, and synthetic complexity into decisions about which records consume a fixed paid training budget.

The paper also rejects the assumption that more synthetic data is automatically better. By showing different effects on easy and hard OOD sets, it frames generated-record complexity as a mixture variable that must be matched to the desired robustness target. This is a useful boundary case for data optimization: selecting for one generalization regime can degrade another.

其新意是实践性的，而不是新的偏好或损失目标。它把数据替换形式化为当服务商锁定微调过程时仍可使用的优化表面。明确的类别平衡替换规则，使难度、不确定性和合成复杂度成为决定哪些记录消耗固定付费训练预算的变量。

论文还否定了更多合成数据必然更好的假设。通过展示它对容易和困难 OOD 集合的不同影响，文章将生成记录复杂度视为必须匹配目标鲁棒性的混合变量。这是数据优化的一个有用边界情形：为一种泛化状态选择数据可能会降低另一种状态。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The evidence is centered on three-way NLI and cannot establish that the same selection rules improve open-ended generation, tool use, or broad instruction following. Difficulty, uncertainty, and benchmark categorization are model- and task-dependent, while synthetic labels can introduce errors not visible from aggregate accuracy. API fine-tuning hides the internal mechanism and limits reproducibility across provider versions. The authors also note that other tasks and more challenging datasets need study; generated data, candidate pools, and source benchmarks require license and contamination checks before reuse.
证据集中于三分类自然语言推理，无法证明相同选择规则可改善开放式生成、工具使用或广泛指令遵循。难度、不确定性和基准划分都依赖模型和任务，而合成标签可能引入汇总准确率看不出的错误。API 微调隐藏内部机制，也限制了跨服务商版本的可复现性。作者还指出需要研究其他任务和更具挑战性的数据集；复用前应检查生成数据、候选池和源基准的许可证与污染问题。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This is useful rather than essential for general-purpose curation, because it is narrowly about NLI robustness. It is highly relevant when a closed-model API fixes the learning algorithm and a team must decide what to replace within a finite paid budget. The paper supplies a disciplined replacement protocol and warns that synthetic complexity and target OOD regime must be chosen together; use it as a design reference, then validate the same trade-off on the target application rather than assuming uncertainty sampling transfers unchanged.
对于通用整理而言，这篇论文是可读而非必读，因为它狭义地关注自然语言推理鲁棒性。当闭源模型 API 固定学习算法、团队必须决定在有限付费预算中替换什么时，它高度相关。论文提供了严谨的替换协议，并警告合成复杂度与目标 OOD 状态必须一起选择；应将它用作设计参考，再在目标应用上验证同样的取舍，而不要假定不确定性抽样能不变迁移。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read Sections 3 and 5 together. Section 3 defines the invariant that makes the intervention interpretable: incoming and removed records are label-balanced and the final set remains fixed at 10K. Section 5 then separates standard-OOD and challenge-OOD outcomes, which prevents the headline of improved robustness from hiding a transfer trade-off. The repository is useful for the exact data construction and API settings, but reproduce with pinned provider versions and independently audit generated examples, since the paper's core conclusion rests on the composition of a constrained training set.
应将第 3 节与第 5 节结合阅读。第 3 节定义了使干预可解释的不变量：进入和移除的记录在标签上平衡，最终集合固定为一万条。第 5 节则区分标准 OOD 和挑战 OOD 结果，防止“鲁棒性提高”的标题掩盖迁移取舍。仓库有助于核验准确的数据构造和 API 设置，但复现时应固定服务商版本并独立审计生成例子，因为论文的核心结论依赖受约束训练集的构成。
